Neg. XII, 6; Sifra Metsora, Neg., Par. 6, ch. IV.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (τέταρτον) tetarton (quarto), uma medida líquida, cerca de um litro de litro.
definicoes_originais: (τέταρτον) tetarton ( quart), a liquid measure, about one quart of a pint.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. VIII, beg. 11 a; Y. Shek. III, 47 b bot.; Y. Pes. X, 37 c top ט' ורביע (not טיטרטין, טט') one and one fourth of a t. (is a ritual cup). Ib. III, 30 a top ט' דמיי בגו מודייה (not טרטון) one t. of water for a modius of wheat.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. próximo w.) tetrapylon, (casa-mansão), nome de um edifício proeminente em Cesaréia Palestina.

notas_originais: Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 13 טטרפלין ed. Zuck. (corr. acc., Var. מטרפלון).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (τετράπυλον) edifícios com quatro portões, mansões proeminentes.
definicoes_originais: (τετράπυλον) buildings with four gates, prominent mansions.
notas_originais: Y. Succ. I, 52 a bot. טו' שבכרכים the tetrapyla (mansions) in fortified cities; Y. Kil. IV, 29 b bot. טי' שבכרמים (corr. acc.).—Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVIII טִטְרָאפִילוֹת Ar. (ed. טטפראות); Yalk. Ps. 756; טטרפאות; Yalk. Zech. 568; B. Bath. 75 b טוטפראות (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50).
Y. Shebi. IV, beg. 35 a איזהו הט' wherein consists the improvement (spoken of in the Mishnah)?

verbetes.glosa_atual: (dialeto. para טַיְיסָן q. v.) tolo orgulhoso.
definicoes_originais: (dialect. for טַיְיסָן q. v.) proud fool.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 26 a גרדנא דלא ט' שתא בציר מְשַׁנֵּי (Ms. M. … טייזיאן משניה, read: טַיְיזָאן) a year (of) scarce earning will change (better) a weaver, if he be no proud fool. [Var. in Ar. s. v. ג' דלטייא׃ גרדנא or דלטייה; Yalk. Gen. 133 … שמתא בצרא …] [The supposed meaning of our w. of humble seems to have risen from a misunderstanding of a running commentary embodied in Rashi a. Tosafoth, where דלא ט' is interpreted עניו.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טוע, cmp. טעי) viajante, esp. Comerciante de caravanas árabes.
definicoes_originais: (טוע, cmp. טעי) traveller, esp. Arabian caravan merchant.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 73 b. Ber. 56 b ט' בעלמא dreaming of an Arab in general (not of Ishmael, the son of Abraham). Men. 69 b כדעדי ט' (Ms. M. בר עדי) as in the case of Adi the merchant; Ab. Zar. 33 a בר עדי ט'. Yeb. 102 a סנדלא דט' וכ' a traveller’s sandal which fits closely.— Pl. טַיָּיעֵי. Sabb. 112 a, v. אוּשְׁכָּפָא. Ab. Zar. 34 b, v. אַבְטָא. B. Bath. 36 a בנהרדעא ט' שכיחי in N. Arabs (stealing cattle) are frequent.

R. to VII, 23 קוסמין בעופות ובקיאין בט' divined from birds and were experts in divination.— Pl. טְיָירִין (טְיָארִין, טִיאוּרִין); חכמת הט' the art of divination. Ib. to X, 20 (ref. to עוף ib.) זה הוא העורב בח' ט' Ar. (ed. חכמת טיאריו, read בח' … ין) that means, the raven (carries the sound) through the art of divination; Midr. Till. to Ps. VII, beg. וח' טיארין; Yalk. Koh. 979 העורב ח' טיאורין … (read בח'); Lev. R. s. 32 וח' טייארין.

Pesik. R. s. 14 the sand stands before the Ocean כט' וכחומה like a dam and a wall (cmp. טִיכְסָא). [It is not likely that our w. is the Greek τεῖχος, which is identical in meaning with חומה.]
Targ. Y. Ex. XXVIII, 8; XXXIX, 5 (h. text אֲפֻדָה).
Y’lamd. Sh’laḥ, quot. in Ar. (v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v.).

Gen. R. s. 63 על טי' דמדינ' Ar. (ed. מטכסא) on the rampart of the fortress (in spite of the gates being closed); Yalk. Gen. 110.— Pl. טִיסְסַיָּיא, טִכְ'. Lam. R. to I, 5 פליג ד' ט' וכ' he assigned the demolition of the four ramparts of the Temple mount to the four generals, and the western gate came under the command of Pangar.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Pilp. de טָמַם); amassar em uma massa coesa e disforme, contrad. para גלגל rolar e moldar a massa.; engrossar, obstruir, esp. para embotar a compreensão.; v’nitmethem (você será contaminado), mas un’tammothem (de טָמַם) (você ficará com o coração embotado); Iaque. Lev. 545.
definicoes_originais: to knead into a cohesive shapeless mass, contrad. to גלגל to roll and shape the dough.
to thicken, obstruct, esp. to blunt the understanding.
v’nitmethem (you will be defiled) but un’tammothem (from טָמַם) (you will become dull-hearted); Yalk. Lev. 545.
notas_originais: Ḥall. III, 1 טִימְטְמָהּ בשעורים after one has formed a lump of barley flour; Tosef. ib. I, 11; a. e.
Pes. 42 a מְטַמְטֵם את הלב obstructs the heart (makes a person dull). Yoma 39 a עבירה מְטַמְטֶמֶת … ונְטַמֹּתֶם Ms. (ed. ונטמטם, corr. acc.) sin dulls the heart of man, read not (Lev. XI, 4
—Ch. טַמְטֵם.
Ḥall. l. c. ותִטַּמְטֵם; Tosef. ib. l. c. יתִיטַּמְטֵים.

Peah I, 15 d bot., a. fr. דלית לה ט' invaluable (cmp. אֲטִימִיטוֹן). Gen. R. s. 2, beg., v. אוֹנִי I. Koh. R. to XI, 9 אייתי ט' מה דאכלת make payment for what thou hast eaten; a. fr.—Y. Shek. I, 64 b bot. טִימִיתֵיה (not … תי) the money received for it; a. fr.—Also: טִימִין (accus. of τιμή). Targ. Y. Gen. XXIII, 15. Targ. Esth. VII, 4.

Zar. 39 a דלא מרבי ט' וכ' (not מרבה) the muddy soil of the river suffers no unclean fish to live in it; Succ. 18 a Ms. M. 2 (ed. טינייהו, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40). III, end, 65 a (prov). מוליכין ט' אצל ט' וכ' mud is carried to mud, and thorns to thorns. Deut. R. s. 5, beg.; Yalk. Prov. 938 מפני הט' on account of the moist soil.
Ḥag. 15 b ט' היתה בלבם there was impurity in their hearts (heathen sensuality). Snh. 75 a העלה לבו ט' a vehement passion seized him (which threatened his health).
, Targ. Y. Lev. XXV, 31, כט' דפריסן, read כטִינָּרֵי דפריסין, v. טִינָּרָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (ampliação de טור; = h. צֹר) o mesmo.
notas_originais: Targ. Job. XXXIX, 28. Targ. O. Ex. IV, 25 טִינָּ' ed. Berl. (ed. Amst. a. Y. טִינְרָא); a. fr.—Gitt. 68 a ומכסיא בט' and covered it up with a stone.— Pl. טִינָּרִין, טִינָּרַיָּא, טִינָּרֵי, טִנָּ'. Targ. Y. I. Num. XXIV, 21 (ed. Amst. טִינְרַ'). Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 15 Ms. (ed. Lag. a. oth. טוּרִין). [Targ. Job. XXVII, 16 טינרין Ms., ed. טינא.]—Trnsf. large, hard tubercles. Ḥull. 48 b דקיימא ט' ט' lungs covered with &c.
Targ. Jud. XV, 15 בט' in the mud (h. text טריה).
Yalk. Ex. 243 טס … ט' אחת flew to Egypt in one flight.

, v. טַיְיעָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. próximo w.) receptáculo de transbordamento, suporte para fogão portátil.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. next w.) receptacle of overflow, a stand for a portable stove.
notas_originais: Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. V, 4.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. טִיפָּה) gotejamento; ט' ט' gotejamento constante.
definicoes_originais: (v. טִיפָּה) dripping; ט' ט' constant dripping.
notas_originais: Pes. 111 b מאן דשתי ט' ט' one who drinks the drippings of wine. Ab. Zar. 30 b מי ט' ט' אין וכ' (Ms. M. omits מי) to liquids which drip into a vessel the rule concerning uncovered liquids does not apply; והוא דעביד ט' ט' בהדי ט' ט' Ms. M. (ed. ט' להדי ט' ט' …, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) provided the drops follow each other without intermission.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ; por favor. טְיָפִין, טְיָפֵי, (טְוָו') טְיָי' (טוף, cmp. precedente. wrds.; duto de transbordamento, canais.; gotas.
definicoes_originais: ; pl. טְיָפִין, טְיָפֵי, (טְוָו') טְיָי' (טוף, cmp. preced. wrds.
notas_originais: , cmp. preced. wrds.)

—Targ. Prov. V, 16 (ed. Lag. טוופי). Targ. Ps. I, 3 טְוָפֵי ed. Wil. (ed. Lag. טורפי, some ed. טרופי, read טוו'). Ib. CXIX, 136. Targ. Job XXIX, 6 (h. text everywhere פלגי). Ib. XX, 17 (h. text פלגות).
Ib. XXXVI, 27 טְיוּפֵי ed. Lag. (oth. ed. טייפי, Ms. טוופי, h. text נטפי).

verbetes.glosa_atual: c. cap. = próximo w. Arakh. 7 a ט' דמ"ה a gota venenosa (na espada) do anjo da morte, v. próximo w.— Pl. טִיפַּיָּיא.
definicoes_originais: c. ch. = next w. Arakh. 7 a ט' דמ"ה the venomous drop (on the sword) of the angel of death, v. next w.— Pl. טִיפַּיָּיא.
notas_originais: Y. Ḥag. II, 78 a top [read:] ביני ט' הוינא מהלכין we walked between the rain drops (so that we did not get wet).

Taan. 6 b על כל ט' וט' וכ' for every drop of rain which thou hast caused to come down for us. Toh. III, 3. Kerith. 13 a ט' מלוכלכת וכ' the drop mixing with the moisture of the nibble. Ab. Zar. 20 b וט' של מרה וכ' and a drop of poison hangs on it (the sword of the angel of death); a. fr.—Y. Nidd. III, 50 d כט' של זבוב like the dripping of a fly (v. infra).— Pl. טִיפִּין, טִיפּוֹת, טִפּ'. Mikv. VIII, 3. Cant. R. to I, 2 מה מים יורדין ט' ט' וכ' as waters come down in drops and form rivers …, so does learning &c. Y. Nidd. l. c.; Bab. ib. 25 a כשתי ט' like two drippings of a fly (Rashi: like the two eye-balls). Hor. 10 a כמה טפות וכ' (Ms. M. טפין, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) how many drops there are in the sea; a. fr.
